g.text: About 1 in 5 researched tonnes retired since 2020 is likely a real reduction (19.4%, range 2.4–68.8%), with no
57% of retired tonnes cannot be tied to a named claimant: 40.9% have a blank beneficiary field, 10.2% say "Not
Disclosed", 6.2% go to resellers, wallets, tokens or codes that match no organisation.
None of the 52 large buyers that research covers well enough to grade reaches a B (36 C, 11 D, 5 E).
Only 4.5% of retired tonnes use a methodology with the ICVCM Core Carbon Principles label.
For 4 of the 14 company groups with both figures, the independent estimate is 3–6× their reported Scope 1 (Shell,
Chevron, E.ON, Eni). Boundaries differ, so this is a question to ask, not a verdict.
